description: Cancelling a live run (no ended record: GET /runs/{id} is 404) from a machine with no live session for it is INVOCATION_INVALID whose Action names the submitting machine's journal or --session UUID, not the generic 'Correct the value named in Detail'.

problem.action: Cancel the run from the machine that submitted it (its run journal holds the live session) or pass that session with --session UUID; nothing was cancelled. Once it ends, read its outcome with `prose --output json cli run show run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c`.

details.reason: run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c has no ended record yet: it is still running (a run's record is written when it ends) or it does not exist, and this machine's run journal has no live session for it. A run's live session is kept in the run journal of the machine that submitted it: cancel it there, or pass --session UUID; once the run ends, `prose --output json cli run show run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c` reads its outcome
